summary: Improve risk assessments, appetite-based prioritisation and board reporting. Explore this five-day ERM course and strengthen your risk practice.
lede: Enterprise risk management coordinates risk information across functions so teams can assess exposure against objectives and risk appetite. The course is for ERM analysts, enterprise risk managers and risk owners who coordinate assessments and responses, with practice in risk classification, appetite-based prioritisation, maintaining risk registers and mitigation plans, monitoring key risk indicators, and preparing executive reports.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate enterprise risk information or own risk responses across business functions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational processes and basic risk terminology is expected. No coding is required. A laptop with access to a spreadsheet and presentation software is useful for the exercises.
